name: Lesnaja Kolybel'naja
source:
The Forest Lullaby is a story about a man, his place in life, how to find a balance between destruction and creation and curb the impulses of his own soul.
And also about adolescents, the formation of personality and the choice of the future, and, of course, about human relationships.
The story is centered on the events of the life of the protagonist - a frivolous guy named Ilya, who lives in a small mountain village called Pearlwood.
Ilya will have to go through two weeks full of sudden events, new acquaintances, endless conversations and unexpected discoveries.
Only on his choices depends on how this story ends. And his choice will not be good or bad - it will be unique, decisive for his personality.
translation:
《森林摇篮曲》讲述一个男人与他在生命中的位置，寻找毁灭与创造之间的平衡，以及抑制灵魂冲动的故事。它也讲述青少年、人格形成、未来选择，当然还有人与人之间的关系。

故事围绕主人公伊利亚的生活展开。他是一个轻浮的年轻人，住在名为珍珠木的小山村里。

伊利亚将度过充满突发事件、新邂逅、无尽对话与意外发现的两周。故事如何结束，取决于他的选择。选择没有好坏之分，却会成为塑造他人格的独特而决定性的因素。
